subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should maintainers require public real embedded-agent proof for this PR's internal-handoff drop and sessions_send preservation paths before merge, or accept equivalent private proof while coordinating with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: The repository proof policy makes external PR real-behavior proof a merge gate, and the diff changes session-state semantics that overlap a second open candidate fix.

options.title: Require Real Embedded-Runner Proof
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording show stale internal handoff text is dropped while sessions_send content is preserved.

options.title: Accept Private Maintainer Proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent runtime evidence and explicitly accept the six-source predicate scope.

options.title: Choose The Other Candidate First
options.body: Pause or close this PR only after maintainers decide that the broader preserve-as-context repair in the other open candidate is the canonical landing path.

recommendation.title: Require Real Embedded-Runner Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording show stale internal handoff text is dropped while sessions_send content is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant and embedded-runner prompt repair boundary.
